method.depth_rank: NFL.com depth charts as mirrored by nflverse (pos_rank 1 = starter).
method.attrition_formula: sum over unavailable starters of position_weight x status_weight; status weights Out=1.0, Doubtful=0.7, Questionable=0.25. Index is rescaled 0-100 against the worst team this week.
limits: Injury status is the official game-status column; it does not prove who starts.
Depth charts are a weekly snapshot, not a snap-count projection.
Practice-squad elevations and game-day inactive lists are not modelled separately.
The attrition index is a modelling assumption, not an official NFL metric.
